title: Security: failed auth is invisible (no 401/403 log, no Caddy access log, no rate limit on login or tokens)
note: CODE READ 2026-11-11: none of the auth checks log a failure (require_session, require_site_session, _require_diag_token, _require_write_token, the login route); the only middleware is CORS; deploy/caddy/Caddyfile has no log directive in the site block. Rate limiting exists only on the Google/passkey routes (10 per 300s per IP, in memory). /api/auth/login answers 403 for a wrong email and 401 for a wrong password. uvicorn's default access log does reach the journal (INFERRED from the unit file; no flag disables it). Fix: one structured log line per 401/403/429 (path, status, hashed client), then the token-probing detector counts it. Detector D2 on SEC-DETECTORS is blocked on this. Tier 2 (web-api).
